items.title: 肯尼亚｜中国路桥获32.2亿先令Old Mombasa Road道路升级合同
items.title_en: Kenya | CRBC wins KES3.22bn Old Mombasa Road upgrade contract
items.summary: 据2026年10月14日报道，中国路桥获得内罗毕Old Mombasa Road约7公里道路升级合同，金额32.2亿肯尼亚先令，包含路面及排水等工作。
items.summary_en: CRBC secured a reported KES3.22bn contract to improve about 7km of Old Mombasa Road in Nairobi, including pavement and drainage works.
items.why_it_matters: 中国承包商中标，后续材料和施工配套具有跟进价值。
items.why_it_matters_en: A named Chinese contractor offers a specific route to follow downstream procurement.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注工程机械、道路材料、排水、土建分包与物流。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track road machinery, paving, drainage, civil subcontracting and logistics.

items.title: 阿曼｜Hot Springs地热项目第二、三阶段咨询招标
items.title_en: Oman | Hot Springs geothermal phases 2–3 consultancy tender
items.summary: Nama PWP为Hot Springs Geothermal Project第二阶段及可选第三阶段征集技术经济咨询服务，涉及地质、地球物理调查、资源评估和钻探方案，编号OPWP/2026/042，11月30日截止。
items.summary_en: Nama PWP invited techno-economic consultancy bids for Phase 2 and optional Phase 3 of its Hot Springs Geothermal Project, covering geological/geophysical surveys, resource assessment and drilling plans; OPWP/2026/042 closes 30 November.
items.why_it_matters: 目前是可行性和资源调查，并非地热电站施工合同。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is a resource-study procurement, not an awarded power-plant construction contract.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注地热勘探、钻探、咨询设备及潜在后续工程。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track geothermal exploration, drilling, technical services and prospective future works.

items.title: 阿尔及利亚｜东部矿业铁路信号、通信及电气化采购线索
items.title_en: Algeria | Eastern mining railway signalling and electrification procurement lead
items.summary: 报道称Anesrif为Annaba–Djebel Onk矿业铁路及相关支线推进铁路信号、通信和电气化采购。具体招标编号、金额及截标日仍待官方文件核验。
items.summary_en: Reports indicate Anesrif is advancing signalling, telecommunications and electrification procurement for the Annaba–Djebel Onk mining rail corridor and branches. Tender reference, budget and deadline need primary-source confirmation.
items.why_it_matters: 与此前Ghardaia–El Meniaa铁路土建合同为不同线索；采购细节仍需验证。
items.why_it_matters_en: Separate from the Ghardaia–El Meniaa civil works award; precise procurement details remain unverified.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注信号系统、通信设备、供电、电缆及安装。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track signalling, telecoms, power systems, cabling and installation.

items.title: 科威特｜天然气增压站升级最低报价约1.32亿美元
items.title_en: Kuwait | Reported US$132m lowest bid for gas booster station upgrade
items.summary: 据行业报道，科威特两座天然气增压站升级项目进入报价评估，Gulf Spic提交约1.32亿美元最低报价；金额及具体站点信息仍需采购方正式公告核验，尚未中标。
items.summary_en: Industry reports indicate Gulf Spic submitted a roughly US$132m lowest bid for gas booster station upgrades in Kuwait. The amount and facility details await official confirmation; no award is established.
items.why_it_matters: 报价评审并不等于授予合同，后续仍须跟进采购结果。
items.why_it_matters_en: Lowest-bid status does not constitute an award; follow the evaluation and final decision.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注压缩机、阀门、电气、仪表和机械安装。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track compressors, valves, electrical, instrumentation and mechanical installation.

items.title: 肯尼亚｜Meru Town道路及两座人行桥施工公开招标
items.title_en: Kenya | Meru Town road upgrades and two footbridges tender
items.summary: KeNHA为Meru Town选定连接道路沥青升级及两座人行桥施工发布公开招标，世界银行项目P161305，招标编号KE-KENHA-533026-CW-RFB，截止2026年11月26日。
items.summary_en: KeNHA is tendering bitumen upgrading of selected Meru Town link roads and construction of two pedestrian footbridges under World Bank project P161305; RFB KE-KENHA-533026-CW-RFB closes 26 November 2026.
items.why_it_matters: 明确土建招标范围及截标时间。
items.why_it_matters_en: A defined civil-works tender with a published deadline provides an actionable opportunity.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注道路施工、桥梁结构、混凝土、沥青及施工设备。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track paving, footbridge structures, concrete, bitumen and construction equipment.

items.title: 巴林｜道路及公园植树绿化工程长期合同招标
items.title_en: Bahrain | Measured term landscaping and afforestation works tender
items.summary: 巴林市政事务与农业部于10月13日公布道路及公园绿化与植树长期工程合同招标，编号MUN-APD-12-2026-M1，11月8日截止；范围包括树木种植、土壤、灌溉管网及维护。
items.summary_en: Bahrain's Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture published tender MUN-APD-12-2026-M1 for roads-and-parks landscaping, planting, irrigation and maintenance on 13 October; closes 8 November.
items.why_it_matters: 官方采购明确，适合景观、灌溉及维护企业。
items.why_it_matters_en: An official procurement with defined landscaping and irrigation scope.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注苗木、绿化工程、泵阀、灌溉管线及维护服务。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track plants, landscaping, pumps, valves, irrigation and maintenance.

items.title: 卡塔尔｜Dukhan机场基地周边道路及基础设施施工招标
items.title_en: Qatar | Dukhan air base surrounding roads and infrastructure tender
items.summary: 卡塔尔公共工程局Ashghal发布Dukhan机场基地周边道路及基础设施工程采购，招标编号PWA/STC/39/2026，公告所列截止日10月25日；须通过官方文件复核资格及投标细节。
items.summary_en: Ashghal lists a road and infrastructure works procurement near Dukhan Air Base, reference PWA/STC/39/2026, with a reported 25 October deadline. Verify eligibility and details in tender documents.
items.why_it_matters: 项目为道路及配套设施，不应误称单纯工程咨询。
items.why_it_matters_en: The scope is road/infrastructure works rather than simply a consultancy engagement.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注道路、排水、材料、机电及土建合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track roads, drainage, materials, MEP and civil partners.

items.title: 巴林｜Tubli污水处理厂项目进入预定开标节点
items.title_en: Bahrain | Tubli wastewater project scheduled tender opening
items.summary: 巴林Tender Board所列SES-25/0028项目涉及Tubli污水处理厂第四期扩建及既有设施的调试、运营和维护，预定10月15日开标。开标安排不代表最终授标。
items.summary_en: Bahrain Tender Board lists SES-25/0028 covering commissioning, operations and maintenance associated with Tubli wastewater treatment facilities; the tender is scheduled for opening on 15 October. No award is implied.
items.why_it_matters: 应跟踪开标结果与后续运维采购，不能作为新签施工合同宣传。
items.why_it_matters_en: Follow bid opening and O&M requirements; do not represent this as an awarded construction contract.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注水处理设备、泵阀、控制系统、运维及工程服务。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track treatment equipment, pumps, valves, controls, O&M and engineering services.
